title: About Us Page

sub_fields.label: Button
sub_fields.name: button
sub_fields.instructions: Optional. Leave empty for a title-and-text section.

sub_fields.label: Section Title
sub_fields.name: section_title
sub_fields.instructions: Title only. The clone's own image and description are not drawn here.

sub_fields.label: Button
sub_fields.name: button
sub_fields.instructions: Optional. Leave empty for a title-and-text section.

sub_fields.label: Section Title
sub_fields.name: section_title
sub_fields.instructions: Title only on this page. Leave the clone's own image and description empty — the picture and the paragraph below are what this section draws.

sub_fields.label: Image
sub_fields.name: image
sub_fields.instructions: Optional picture above the paragraph, on the left. The About Us frame has none: leave it empty and the paragraph sits on its own beside the right-hand picture.

sub_fields.label: Text
sub_fields.name: text
sub_fields.instructions: The paragraph on the left, columns 2-5.

sub_fields.label: Secondary image
sub_fields.name: image_secondary
sub_fields.instructions: The picture on the right, columns 7-11, running the full height of the section. This is the one the About Us frame shows.

sub_fields.label: Enable video
sub_fields.name: enable_video
sub_fields.instructions: When on, the video takes the right column's place.

sub_fields.label: Section Title
sub_fields.name: section_title
sub_fields.instructions: Title only. The clone's own image and description are not drawn here — the video and the text below are.

sub_fields.label: Image
sub_fields.name: image
sub_fields.instructions: The poster while the video loads, the fallback if it cannot play, and the picture itself when there is no video.

sub_fields.label: Vimeo link
sub_fields.name: vimeo
sub_fields.instructions: Paste the Vimeo share link, the player link, or the whole embed code — all of them work. Use this for anything longer than a few seconds: a file in the media library is served at one bitrate to everyone, where Vimeo adapts to the connection. Filled, it replaces the uploaded video below, the box follows the film's 16:9, and the Image above becomes the poster behind a play button — Vimeo is only contacted once a visitor presses it.

sub_fields.label: Video (webm)
sub_fields.name: video_webm
sub_fields.instructions: The smaller of the two. Upload the file itself — a Drive or YouTube link is a page, not a video.

sub_fields.label: Image
sub_fields.name: image
sub_fields.instructions: Optional. Spans the section's ten columns at a 1514x450 ratio.

sub_fields.label: Overline
sub_fields.name: title
sub_fields.instructions: The small label above the button.

description: About Us page sections. The hero comes from the shared "Hero Section" group, which already covers every page template but the home.
